description: Withdraw a coin from your own BalanceManager back to your address (always to the owner). Returns UNSIGNED tx bytes (simulated against mainnet). Non-custodial: the desk never sees or holds keys and never moves funds; it returns quotes and UNSIGNED transactions only. Spot only, no leverage. Education only, not financial advice.

amount.description: Amount of the from coin in human units, e.g. 2.5

balance_manager_id.description: YOUR DeepBook BalanceManager id (0x + 64 hex), from build_create_balance_manager_tx effects

coin.description: Coin symbol: SUI, USDC, WAL, DEEP, CETUS

sender.description: YOUR Sui address (0x...). Public address only; never send a key.

name: build_bm_withdraw_tx
title: Build: withdraw from my BalanceManager
